strategy.summary: Strengthen test/pricing.test.js so the 6 surviving mutants in src/pricing.js are killed: assert exact return values of applyCoupon in the two tests that currently assert nothing/only toBeDefined, add boundary cases at $50 shipping and $100 coupon, and add an orderTotal case where shipping is actually charged. Expected values come from the README and JSDoc (free shipping from $50; SAVE20 only over $100; total = discounted + shipping). Existing tests keep their titles and assertions; only assertions and cases are added.
inScope: applyCoupon with no coupon, small order, and boundary 100
outOfScope: The 2 mutants no test reaches (formatPrice), per the work item
Any restructuring of the existing test file beyond adding assertions and cases
assumptions: README and JSDoc state the intended behaviour; they agree with the code.
Existing tests keep their titles and assertions; only assertions are added to them.

risks.description: Floating-point rounding in orderTotal could make an exact assertion fragile
risks.mitigation: Use inputs whose total 24.99 is produced by the code's own cent rounding.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Shipping is free for a subtotal of exactly $50 (and above).
A missing or non-SAVE20 coupon leaves the subtotal unchanged, even over $100.
SAVE20 leaves a subtotal of $100 or less unchanged, including exactly $100.
orderTotal adds shipping to the discounted subtotal when shipping is charged.

testCases.title: ships an order of exactly $50 for free
handles an order without a coupon
testCases.expected: returns 200 (strengthens the existing test, which asserted nothing)
testCases.rationale: Kills mutants 1 (condition -> true) and 2 (&& -> ||) at pricing.js:11:7: subtotal over 100 with no SAVE20 code.

testCases.title: handles a small order with the coupon
testCases.expected: returns 50 (adds toBe(50) beside the existing toBeDefined)

testCases.title: does not discount an order of exactly $100 with SAVE20
adds the shipping charge to a small order
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 6 (+ to - at 21:22); the existing case has free shipping so + and - agree.
